description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing category-related state in a React-Redux application, including fetching, adding, updating, activating, and deleting categories, as well as handling form changes and errors.

methods.name: categoryChange
methods.description: Creates an action to change a category form field value.

methods.name: categoryEditChange
methods.description: Creates an action to change a category edit form field value.

methods.name: categorySelect
methods.description: Creates an action for selecting a category.

methods.name: resetCategory
methods.description: Dispatches an action to reset the category form state.

methods.name: fetchStoreCategories
methods.description: Fetches store categories from API and dispatches to store.

methods.name: fetchCategories
methods.description: Fetches all categories from API and dispatches to store.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches a specific category by ID from API.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Validates and adds a new category via API.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Validates and updates an existing category via API.

methods.name: activateCategory
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a category via API.
